annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council on general product safety
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council on general product safety
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities C 337 E
annotation.summary_en: Commission proposal (COM(2000) 139) recasting Directive 92/59/EEC on general product safety. It sets a general safety requirement for consumer products, producer and distributor obligations, market surveillance duties for Member States, the RAPEX rapid alert system and a European Product Safety Network. It contains no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Producers must place only safe products on the market (general safety requirement).
Conformity with European standards gives a presumption of safety.
Producers and distributors must inform authorities of dangerous products and withdraw or recall them.
Member States must set up market surveillance authorities and penalties.
RAPEX rapid information system and Commission decisions for serious risks.
